prompt.alinti: Number one is the chief of staff skill. It came out last week and it gives Claude one big goal and it runs a whole team of AI agents in the background to get it done.
Number two is the anatomy skill. Ask Claude to explain anything technical and instead of text, it builds an interactive machine you can actually play with.
Number three is the teach skill. Tell Claude what you want to learn and it becomes your personal tutor: it writes your lessons, makes cheat sheets and remembers exactly where you left off.
Number four is the marketing psychology skill. It gives Claude over 50 psychology principles, like loss aversion and pricing tricks, and uses them on your marketing.
And number five is the last 30 days skill. Give it any topic and it digs through Reddit, X, YouTube and TikTok to tell you exactly what people said about it last month.
